calculation.expression: -((P_t/P_{t-3}-1) - beta_60(asset, equal_weight_benchmark)*sum_3d(benchmark_return)) conditioned on benchmark 5d return > 0 and benchmark 20d volatility below its trailing 252d 75th percentile
calculation.description: Ranks assets by negative three-day beta-residual return, activating in constructive benchmark regimes whose volatility is not above the trailing upper quartile. Higher values indicate idiosyncratic short-term underperformance expected to mean-revert over the next 10 trading days. Inputs use only information available at signal date.

validation.regime_notes: 1263 valid daily cross-sectional observations using all 15 instruments. Aggregate IC and ICIR pass benchmark gates.
